scope: Proposition 9.2 (Chart persistence) of the manuscript “Planar Graph Metrics Embed into L1 with Constant Distortion” (preprints/Planar-Graph-Metrics-Embed-into-L1-with-Constant-Distortion-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 11b3a102e7333bf8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist constants C0 < ∞ and ρ0 > 0 such that the following holds. Condition on the past at a step of scale r. Suppose a fixed closed ball Bd(v, ρr) lies in a single old region in each system. For 0 < ρ ≤ ρ0, the probability that this ball is split between different new regions in either system is at most C0(ρ + η0). (42) Here η0 is the relative mesh allowance from Section 5.2.
